property.name: MINIO_BROWSER
property.description: Enable the browser console: on or off. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: MINIO_REGION_NAME
property.description: S3 region name. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: MINIO_API_REQUESTS_MAX
property.description: Maximum concurrent API requests; zero uses automatic sizing. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: MINIO_API_REQUESTS_DEADLINE
property.description: Maximum time requests wait for an execution slot. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: MINIO_COMPRESSION_ENABLE
property.description: Enable compression for eligible objects. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: MINIO_COMPRESSION_EXTENSIONS
property.description: File extensions eligible for compression. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: MINIO_COMPRESSION_MIME_TYPES
property.description: MIME types eligible for compression. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.
